title: Shipping overview
text: Shipping unions each authorized project’s live/recent window and presents shared releases once. Project chips match member projects or an itemless run’s owner. An explicit Shipping entry reads its authorized overview alongside project and saved-selection startup; first paint keeps the saved filter. Shipping shows loading, then available cards and source-only Not started rows before auxiliary evidence or flow names; missing facts stay loading or refused. Member QA retains the release gate’s acceptance authority, and landing attribution keeps the first successful delivery in each environment. Deployed timing remains subject to production proof. Each presentation batches current QA facts with canonical acceptance checks: unrun cases stay unrun; later calls see changed withdrawals and verdicts. Environment names, case definitions, copy targets and decoded source bindings are reused only within one overview. All deployment-run lists, cards and QA facts omit driver preparation receipts; detail and recovery retain them. Query plans alone exclude transport, decoding and Python work; actual execution counts and deployed timing remain required. Executable QA content identity treats equal JSON numeric values such as 180 and 180.0 alike. Serialization alone cannot make a matching deployment copy appear source-only; changed values or JSON types still mean changed content. Completed execution rows are read once for displayed runs; selected rows retain the canonical roster and target checks, and later requests reread changed execution evidence. The run page, Shipping and the Inbox share one grouping and count rule from the run-scoped QA activity read: each plan group is drawn once under Run QA, keyed by its group id and labelled with the items it answers; a plan reads pending until item-qa creates its group, and a closed group from an earlier run is labelled as such. Each attaching item shows only its own item cases plus one pointer per attached plan to Run QA; an item with only plans shows only those pointers. Every check counts once: retracted and superseded checks leave passed, queued and open counts and appear only in history, and a removed member shows as removed with its cancelled count rather than as open QA. A result a takeover carried from an earlier run names that run and reads as open, not as this run's failure. Production presentation of a live release with plan groups remains to be proven. Verdict reads omit output but preserve actual-attempt order and ambiguity checks; full details retain output. Member obligation and acceptance reads reuse frozen item-case snapshots per evaluation; plan groups read live attachments; copy matching reads identity and executable fields. Cards read recorded exact-target QA without provider calls; admission and release gates retain ancestry proof. Overview component logs reuse the timing emitter; overlapping DB, QA and repository times are not additive or browser proof. Shipping warms one renderer import alongside startup reads; rendering waits for saved scope. Other screens load on demand. Loading and module refusal remain visible, and navigation or unmount discards late rendering.
